verdict.rationale: LocalAI ships a first-party `local-ai chat` command that runs as an agent in your own shell, answering questions conversationally and asking approval before state-changing commands. That directly delivers a terminal chat session with a local model. missing for 10: documentation of how to pick a specific model and session options for `local-ai chat`, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the interactive terminal experience.

support.subject: As a developer, I can start an interactive chat session with a model directly from the terminal

citations.quote: an agent in your own shell. local-ai chat reads your files and runs commands on your machine, behind an approval gate you control.
`local-ai chat`, an agent in your shell that runs commands behind an approval gate.
It answers questions, reads your files and runs commands on your machine, asking you to approve anything that changes state.
